Title: HoloLens 2 Development Edition expands to new markets

Body.Content:
After launching in the United States in November 2020, we are announcing the availability of HoloLens 2 Development Edition in Canada, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, Ireland, and the United Kingdom. 

The Development Edition combines the capabilities of HoloLens 2 with Azure, Unity, and Pixyz to empower developers to build interactive experiences and render 3D holographic content with people, places, and things. 

Learn more
